protocol.view_requirement: One continuous broadcast shot with a fixed lane quadrilateral; suspected cuts are excluded from the interval.
protocol.count_definition: Freestyle/backstroke count each arm event; breaststroke/butterfly count each synchronous arm cycle. Kicks are model outputs unless independently visible enough to label.
protocol.accuracy_rule: Detection coverage is reported separately from count accuracy. Count accuracy remains unverified until ground_truth contains independent human labels.

count_accuracy.reason: The sampled broadcast clips have no independent event labels, and many kicks are not visually resolvable at source resolution. Predictions are not reused as truth.
